title: A transparent crypto‑trading project I’ve been building: HEXORYN (with public Proof of Signals)
author: rfsant
selftext:
I’ve been working on a side project for the past weeks and finally pushed it live: **HEXORYN**, a crypto‑trading terminal focused on *transparency, reproducibility and verifiable signals*.

One thing that always bothered me in this space is how easy it is to post pretty backtests or cherry‑picked screenshots with no way for anyone to verify anything. So instead of just building another bot, I built a system where **every signal leaves a public, timestamped, cryptographic proof**.

No “trust me bro”, no hindsight tuning, no disappearing trades.

# 🔍 What HEXORYN does

* Generates rule‑based signals (no ML, no black boxes)
* Tracks them in real time
* Publishes a **public Proof of Signals** page where anyone can audit what was generated and when
* Uses reproducible profiles so results can be independently checked

# 🧪 Why I built it

Because the algo‑trading space is full of unverifiable claims.  
If someone says a strategy works, they should be able to **prove** it.

# 🌐 Live demo

Main site: [https://hexoryn.pt](https://hexoryn.pt)    
Public proofs: [https://hexoryn.pt/proofs](https://hexoryn.pt/proofs)

It’s still early stage, but fully online.  
If anyone here is into transparency layers, verifiable signals, or reproducible trading systems, I’d love feedback.

comments.author: rfsant
comments.body:
Just running in **Paper Mode on Windows**, with **Telegram notifications** enabled — including automatic **Long/Short**, **Break‑Even**, **Trailing Stop**, and **TP Extension** management.

The Telegram integration is great for real‑time awareness, but the real power is in **Windows Mode**, where you get:

* **AI Gate** filtering signals in real time
* **Backtest Profiles** automatically loaded per token pair
* **Consistent behaviour** between backtests, paper mode and live mode

It’s the closest you can get to a fully supervised trading workflow without babysitting the terminal.
